title: channels__recv — output
description: Output schema for the channels__recv MCP tool. Returns messages accumulated since the last drain, marked as delivered to this agent atomically. Defined in CONTRACTS.md §5.2.

drained_at.description: Unix epoch seconds (floating point) at which this drain operation completed in the backing store.

messages.description: Ordered list of messages drained. Within each channel, messages are in send-time order (ascending sent_at). Across channels, order is unspecified. Each element conforms to spec/schemas/message.schema.json (inlined here for standalone schema compilation).

channel.description: Name of the channel this message was sent to.

sender.description: agent_id of the agent that sent the message.

body.description: Opaque message payload. See CONTRACTS.md §9 for recommended field conventions.

correlation_id.description: Optional correlation token. Null if not supplied by the sender.

sent_at.description: Unix epoch seconds at which the backing store accepted the message.

message_id.description: Backing-store-assigned unique identifier for this message.
